# 圓覺經精解評林

**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 明 焦竑纂
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0261

## Contributors
- 焦竑 (A001310)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 1-fascicle critical-evaluative anthology of glosses on the *Yuánjué jīng* ([KR6i0551](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0551)) compiled by the late-Míng polymath [焦竑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A6%E7%AB%91) Jiāo Hóng 焦竑 (1540–1620). The work is in the *pínglín* 評林 ("forest of critical evaluations") format characteristic of the late-Wàn-lì literati commentary genre, which Jiāo Hóng helped popularise across the Buddhist canon. Each section of the sūtra-text is followed by a sequence of comments drawn from earlier commentators (chiefly [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì, but also [孝宗帝](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%9D%E5%AE%97%E5%B8%9D) Sòng Xiàozōng, [元粹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%B2%B9) Yuáncuì, and others), with Jiāo Hóng's own *bǔzhù* 補註 (supplementary notes) woven through. The result is a compact, classroom-and-private-study commentary aimed at the educated lay-Buddhist literati readership that was Jiāo's principal audience throughout his Buddhist publications.

**Abstract**

The signature line at the head of the work — 太史漪園焦竑弱侯父纂 — identifies Jiāo by his court title (*tàishǐ* 太史, "Senior Historian", his Hànlín appointment), his sobriquet Yīyuán 漪園, his given name Hóng 竑, his *zì* Ruòhóu 弱侯, and the kinship-honorific *fù* 父 ("father"); the editorial action is *zuǎn* 纂 ("compile"). The work has no autograph preface fixing its date; it must be earlier than Jiāo's death in 1620 and most likely later than his 1589 *zhuàngyuán* attainment, which provides the conventional terminus a quo for his major literary publications. The active period 1589–1620 is therefore the appropriate compositional window; further narrowing is not possible from internal evidence.

The *Jīngjiě pínglín* is part of Jiāo's extensive Buddhist commentary cycle, which also includes his [KR6d0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0078) *Fǎhuá jīng jīngjiě pínglín* 法華經精解評林 (X31 no. 612) on the *Lotus Sūtra*. Jiāo's *pínglín* genre as a whole reflects the late-Wàn-lì conjunction of literati intellectual culture and Buddhist publishing: extensive use of woodblock printing, anthological-critical exegetical method, and literati patronage of the monastic canon-publishing projects. Jiāo himself was a major patron of the *Jiāxīngzàng* 嘉興藏 project; his commentaries circulated in close interaction with that monumental publishing enterprise.
